actions.label: Update node
actions.model_hint: Patch an existing node by nodeId|id (keeps z-order). Geometry: x,y,width,height. Morph shape: shapeType|type=rect|ellipse|circle|triangle|polygon|star|line|arrow|… (rect→circle = update_node shapeType=circle on same id — NEVER delete+create_shape). Style: fill,stroke,borderWidth,strokeAlign=center|inside|outside (default center; selection chrome sits on mid of stroke band), strokeStyle, strokeLinecap, strokeLinejoin, strokeOpacity, opacity,cornerRadius,rotation,blendMode,name, flipX/flipY, text styles…. Visibility/edit: hidden, locked (boolean).

actions.label: Create shape
actions.model_hint: Add a shape. Args: shapeType|type = rect|ellipse|circle|line|arrow|triangle|polygon|star|path|pen|pencil (+ path for pen/pencil/path; sides for polygon/star), x,y,width,height, fill, stroke, borderWidth, strokeAlign=center|inside|outside (default center — ink + selection indicator sit on stroke mid-band; outside/inside shift the band). Optional: strokeStyle, strokeLinecap, strokeLinejoin, strokeOpacity. Pen=pen+path; brush=pencil+path (stroke-only; brushStyle?; pathPressure?). Line/arrow are open center strokes (full arrow path includes head). Icons: create_svg / create_icon.

args_schema.path: string? SVG d or point list for pen/pencil
args_schema.name: string?

actions.label: Create text
actions.model_hint: Add a text node. Args: text, x, y, width?, fontSize?, fill?, fontWeight?, fontFamily?. fontFamily MUST be chosen from the Available fonts catalog when the style exists there. Do not invent font names.

actions.label: Outline text
actions.model_hint: Convert text node(s) to editable path letterforms (fontkit). Args: nodeId|id or nodeIds[]. Target must be text with content. After outline: style with update_node fill/stroke; combine letterforms with boolean_op. Prefer create_text + fontFamily from Available fonts when the style exists there; use outline_text when you need path geometry (boolean, warp, stroke-only glyphs). FE runs this async — do not expect sync create_shape path as a substitute unless fonts cannot outline.

actions.label: Create image
actions.model_hint: Add an image node. Args: src|url or attachmentIndex (user attach), x,y,width,height. Or genPrompt for AI image hydrate. Optional letteringText=visible text in the image (helps later replaceText). Finished poster refs with baked text: STYLE only — prefer genPrompt clean bg, not full-bleed attachmentIndex. Lettering: ONLY when Needed style is NOT in Available fonts (brush calligraphy / 3D / decorative effects) → genPrompt + letteringText; otherwise use create_text + fontFamily from the fonts catalog.

actions.label: Create SVG
actions.model_hint: Add SVG icon/illustration. Args: svg (required), x,y,width,height, fill?. svg = full <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24">…</svg> OR fragment (<path d="…"/> / <circle…/>). path d: use spaced commands Mm Ll Hh Vv Cc Ss Qq Tt Aa Zz + numbers; never glue arc params (bad: a22001…). Backend rejects invalid SVG and retries.

actions.label: Create icon
actions.model_hint: Same as create_svg for icons. Prefer viewBox 0 0 24 24; valid path d only.

actions.label: Create frame
actions.model_hint: Create a frame/artboard. Args: x,y,width,height, name?

actions.label: Delete nodes
actions.model_hint: Remove nodes by id. Args: nodeIds (string[]). Only when user asked to delete.

actions.label: Update frame
actions.model_hint: Update frame size/name/background/lock. Args: frameId|id (must match FOCUS_FRAME_ID when set), width?, height?, name?, backgroundColor?, locked? (boolean — prevent moving/resizing the artboard). When FOCUS_FRAME_ID is present, always use that id — never retarget by name.

actions.label: Delete frame
actions.model_hint: Delete a frame. Args: frameId|id from SCENE_FRAMES. Destructive — first turn must ask confirmation via choice_ui (mode=confirm, apply+dismiss) or legacy reply+choices; emit this op only after user confirms. Never put ids in reply.

actions.label: Align nodes
actions.model_hint: Align 2+ nodes. Args: nodeIds, mode=left|centerX|right|top|middle|bottom (FE reads mode; centerX not center).

actions.label: Distribute nodes
actions.model_hint: Distribute 3+ nodes. Args: nodeIds, axis=h|v (h=horizontal, v=vertical)

actions.label: Reorder z-index
actions.model_hint: Z-order. Args: nodeIds, action=front|back|forward|backward

actions.label: Group
actions.model_hint: Group nodes. Args: nodeIds

actions.label: Ungroup
actions.model_hint: Ungroup. Args: nodeIds (group ids)

actions.label: Duplicate nodes
actions.model_hint: Duplicate nodes. Args: nodeIds, offsetX?, offsetY?

actions.label: Flip nodes
actions.model_hint: Flip nodes. Args: nodeIds, flipX?=true and/or flipY?=true

actions.label: Boolean ops
actions.model_hint: Boolean on shapes. Args: nodeIds (2+), mode=union|subtract|intersect|exclude

actions.label: Canvas background
actions.model_hint: Set infinite-canvas stage background (not artboard fill). Args: color|fill|backgroundColor, fillType?=solid|linear|radial|angular|diffuse|image, fillEnd?, gradientAngle?, opacity?

actions.label: Viewport
actions.model_hint: Zoom/fit. Args: action=zoom_in|zoom_out|fit|set; for set pass percent (e.g. 100) or zoom (1.0).

actions.label: Image process
actions.model_hint: Run image toolbar pipeline on a node (spawns processing clone). Args: nodeId (image id), kind=upscale|removeBg|eraser|editText|editElements|replaceText|multiAngle|expand|adjust|crop|flipRotate|moveObject|vector. replaceText=i2i swap lettering (meta.originalText + meta.newText); editText=OCR text layers; editElements=subjects+text+bg. Optional: targetWidth, targetHeight, meta (object).

actions.label: Export
actions.model_hint: Export canvas/selection download. Args: format=png|jpeg|svg, nodeIds? (selection), multiplier? (scale, default 1), filename?
